en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST FORM URL
en.DESCRIPTION: Absolute https address of the published request-a-quote form. The primary button in the top bar opens it. Any other scheme is discarded and the button stays inert.

en.NAME: PORTAL WEATHER CLIENT ID
en.DESCRIPTION: Xweather client ID for the service-area forecast on the home screen. It is visible in page source, as every Xweather browser credential is, so restrict its namespace in the Xweather account to the host that serves this page. The forecast is requested only while both this and PORTAL_WEATHER_CLIENT_SECRET hold a key; the # it ships with means not set, and the home screen then says the forecast is not set up.

en.NAME: PORTAL WEATHER CLIENT SECRET
en.DESCRIPTION: Xweather client secret paired with PORTAL_WEATHER_CLIENT_ID. Xweather sends it from the browser, so it is visible in page source too; restrict the namespace to the host that serves this page. The forecast is requested only while both hold a key; the # it ships with means not set.

en.NAME: PORTAL MAPS API KEY
en.DESCRIPTION: Google Maps browser key for the property map on the home screen. It is visible in page source, as every browser key is, so restrict it by HTTP referrer to this host and to the Maps JavaScript API and the Geocoding API. Addresses of properties without stored coordinates are sent to the Geocoding API. While it holds the # it ships with, no Google script is loaded and the home screen lists the properties without a map.

en.NAME: PORTAL MAPS MAP ID
en.DESCRIPTION: Optional Google Cloud map ID that styles the property map, created in the same Google Cloud project as PORTAL_MAPS_API_KEY. It is not a secret. While it holds the # it ships with, the map uses Google's default style.

en.NAME: PORTAL TIME ZONE
en.DESCRIPTION: IANA time zone of the service organization, the same as its Organization.timeZone in Core, for example America/Vancouver. Recorded moments such as when a visit started or was completed, and which day is today, are shown in this zone whatever the viewer's device says. Planned visit windows are stored as local times and are shown as stored. A value that is not a time zone falls back to the viewer's device zone.

en.NAME: PORTAL TAXES NOTE
en.DESCRIPTION: Customer portal copy shown under every quote price and total, which are the charges before taxes: the taxes are added when the customer accepts a quote and are shown on invoices. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRM TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the page the Confirm my request button of the first quote request email opens. Nothing is sent until the visitor presses the button on it. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRM BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the confirm title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: Confirm that you asked us for a quote, and we will start preparing it.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRM BUTTON
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the button that confirms the quote request. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCEL TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the page the Unsubscribe link of the first quote request email opens. Nothing is sent until the visitor presses the button on it. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCEL BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the cancel title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: We will not prepare a quote, and you will receive no more emails about this request. This cannot be undone.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCEL BUTTON
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the button that cancels the quote request. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRMING
en.DESCRIPTION: Shown while the confirmation is being sent and read back. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRMED TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the page shown once a quote request is confirmed from its email. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CONFIRMED BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the confirmed title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: Thank you. Your request is being processed, and we will be in touch.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCELLING
en.DESCRIPTION: Shown while the cancellation is being sent and read back. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCELLED TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title of the page shown once a quote request is cancelled from the Unsubscribe link. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST CANCELLED BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the cancelled title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: We will not prepare a quote, and no more emails will be sent about this request.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK INVALID TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title shown when a confirmation or Unsubscribe link was already used or its request already left the waiting state. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: This link is no longer valid

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK INVALID BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the invalid link title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: It may already have been used, or the request was already confirmed or cancelled.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK FAILED TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title shown when the confirmation or cancellation could not be sent; the link stays usable. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: We could not reach our system

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK FAILED BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the unreachable title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: Nothing was changed. Check your connection and try again.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK RETRY
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the button that sends the confirmation or cancellation again. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK UNCONFIRMED TITLE
en.DESCRIPTION: Title shown when the confirmation or cancellation was sent but the system has not recorded it. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: We could not confirm that yet

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK UNCONFIRMED BODY
en.DESCRIPTION: Line under the not confirmed yet title. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.

value.en: Our system has not recorded it. Check again in a moment. If this does not change, the request was already confirmed or cancelled.

en.NAME: PORTAL REQUEST LINK CHECK AGAIN
en.DESCRIPTION: Label of the button that reads the outcome again. Translate it per language; an empty value shows the English default.
